passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.1
passages.text: Quam mihi misisti verbis, Leandre, salutem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.2
passages.text: Ut possim missam rebus habere, veni!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.3
passages.text: Longa mora est nobis omnis, quae gaudia differt.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.4
passages.text: Da veniam fassae; non patienter amo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.5
passages.text: Urimur igne pari, sed sum tibi viribus inpar:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.6
passages.text: Fortius ingenium suspicor esse viris.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.7
passages.text: Ut corpus, teneris ita mens infirma puellis —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.8
passages.text: Deficiam, parvi temporis adde moram!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.9
passages.text: Vos modo venando, modo rus geniale colendo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.10
passages.text: Ponitis in varia tempora longa mora.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.11
passages.text: Aut fora vos retinent aut unctae dona palaestrae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.12
passages.text: Flectitis aut freno colla sequacis equi;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.13
passages.text: Nunc volucrem laqueo, nunc piscem ducitis hamo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.14
passages.text: Diluitur posito serior hora mero.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.15
passages.text: His mihi summotae, vel si minus acriter urar,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.16
passages.text: Quod faciam, superest praeter amare nihil.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.17
passages.text: Quod superest facio, teque, o mea sola voluptas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.18
passages.text: Plus quoque, quam reddi quod mihi possit, amo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.19
passages.text: Aut ego cum cana de te nutrice susurro,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.20
passages.text: Quaeque tuum, miror, causa moretur iter;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.21
passages.text: Aut mare prospiciens odioso concita vento

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.22
passages.text: Corripio verbis aequora paene tuis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.23
passages.text: Aut, ubi saevitiae paulum gravis unda remisit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.24
passages.text: Posse quidem, sed te nolle venire, queror;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.25
passages.text: Dumque queror lacrimae per amantia lumina manant,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.26
passages.text: Pollice quas tremulo conscia siccat anus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.27
passages.text: Saepe tui specto si sint in litore passus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.28
passages.text: Inpositas tamquam servet harena notas;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.29
passages.text: Utque rogem de te et scribam tibi, siquis Abydo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.30
passages.text: Venerit, aut, quaero, siquis Abydon eat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.31
passages.text: Quid referam, quotiens dem vestibus oscula, quas tu

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.32
passages.text: Hellespontiaca ponis iturus aqua?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.33
passages.text: Sic ubi lux acta est et noctis amicior hora

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.34
passages.text: Exhibuit pulso sidera clara die,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.35
passages.text: Protinus in summo vigilantia lumina tecto

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.36
passages.text: Ponimus, adsuetae signa notamque viae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.37
passages.text: Tortaque versato ducentes stamina fuso

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.38
passages.text: Feminea tardas fallimus arte moras.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.39
passages.text: Quid loquar interea tam longo tempore, quaeris?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.40
passages.text: Nil nisi Leandri nomen in ore meo est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.41
passages.text: 'Iamne putas exisse domo mea gaudia, nutrix,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.42
passages.text: An vigilant omnes, et timet ille suos?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.43
passages.text: Iamne suas umeris illum deponere vestes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.44
passages.text: Pallade iam pingui tinguere membra putas?'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.45
passages.text: Adnuit illa fere; non nostra quod oscula curet,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.46
passages.text: Sed movet obrepens somnus anile caput.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.47
passages.text: Postque morae minimum 'iam certe navigat,' inquam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.48
passages.text: 'Lentaque dimotis bracchia iactat aquis.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.49
passages.text: Paucaque cum tacta perfeci stamina terra,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.50
passages.text: An medio possis, quaerimus, esse freto.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.51
passages.text: Et modo prospicimus, timida modo voce precamur,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.52
passages.text: Ut tibi det faciles utilis aura vias;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.53
passages.text: Auribus incertas voces captamus, et omnem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.54
passages.text: Adventus strepitum credimus esse tui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.55
passages.text: Sic ubi deceptae pars est mihi maxima noctis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.56
passages.text: Acta, subit furtim lumina fessa sopor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.57
passages.text: Forsitan invitus mecum tamen, inprobe, dormis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.58
passages.text: Et, quamquam non vis ipse venire, venis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.59
passages.text: Nam modo te videor prope iam spectare natantem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.60
passages.text: Bracchia nunc umeris umida ferre meis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.61
passages.text: Nunc dare, quae soleo, madidis velamina membris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.62
passages.text: Pectora nunc nostro iuncta fovere sinu

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.63
passages.text: Multaque praeterea linguae reticenda modestae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.64
passages.text: Quae fecisse iuvat, facta referre pudet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.65
passages.text: Me miseram! brevis est haec et non vera voluptas;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.66
passages.text: Nam tu cum somno semper abire soles.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.67
passages.text: Firmius, o, cupidi tandem coeamus amantes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.68
passages.text: Nec careant vera gaudia nostra fide!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.69
passages.text: Cur ego tot viduas exegi frigida noctes?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.70
passages.text: Cur totiens a me, lente morator, abes?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.71
passages.text: Est mare, confiteor, non nunc tractabile nanti;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.72
passages.text: Nocte sed hesterna lenior aura fuit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.73
passages.text: Cur ea praeterita est? cur non ventura timebas?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.74
passages.text: Tam bona cur periit, nec tibi rapta via est?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.75
passages.text: Protinus ut similis detur tibi copia cursus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.76
passages.text: Hoc melior certe, quo prior, illa fuit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.77
passages.text: At cito mutata est pacati forma profundi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.78
passages.text: Tempore, cum properas, saepe minore venis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.79
passages.text: Hic, puto, deprensus nil, quod querereris, haberes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.80
passages.text: Meque tibi amplexo nulla noceret hiemps.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.81
passages.text: Certe ego tum ventos audirem laeta sonantis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.82
passages.text: Et numquam placidas esse precarer aquas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.83
passages.text: Quid tamen evenit, cur sis metuentior undae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.84
passages.text: Contemptumque prius nunc vereare fretum?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.85
passages.text: Nam memini, cum te saevum veniente minaxque

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.86
passages.text: Non minus, aut multo non minus, aequor erat;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.87
passages.text: Cum tibi clamabam: 'sic tu temerarius esto,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.88
passages.text: Ne miserae virtus sit tua flenda mihi!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.89
passages.text: Unde novus timor hic, quoque illa audacia fugit?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.90
passages.text: Magnus ubi est spretis ille natator aquis?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.91
passages.text: Sis tamen hoc potius, quam quod prius esse solebas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.92
passages.text: Et facias placidum per mare tutus iter —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.93
passages.text: Dummodo sis idem, dum sic, ut scribis, amemur,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.94
passages.text: Flammaque non fiat frigidus illa cinis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.95
passages.text: Non ego tam ventos timeo mea vota morantes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.96
passages.text: Quam similis vento ne tuus erret amor,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.97
passages.text: Ne non sim tanti, superentque pericula causam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.98
passages.text: Et videar merces esse labore minor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.99
passages.text: Interdum metuo, patria ne laedar et inpar

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.100
passages.text: Dicar Abydeno Thressa puella toro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.101
passages.text: Ferre tamen possum patientius omnia, quam si

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.102
passages.text: Otia nescio qua paelice captus agis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.103
passages.text: In tua si veniunt alieni colla lacerti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.104
passages.text: Fitque novus nostri finis amoris amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.105
passages.text: A, potius peream, quam crimine vulnerer isto,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.106
passages.text: Fataque sint culpa nostra priora tua!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.107
passages.text: Nec, quia venturi dederis mihi signa doloris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.108
passages.text: Haec loquor aut fama sollicitata nova.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.109
passages.text: Omnia sed vereor — quis enim securus amavit?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.110
passages.text: Cogit et absentes plura timere locus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.111
passages.text: Felices illas, sua quas praesentia nosse

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.112
passages.text: Crimina vera iubet, falsa timere vetat!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.113
passages.text: Nos tam vana movet, quam facta iniuria fallit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.114
passages.text: Incitat et morsus error uterque pares.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.115
passages.text: O utinam venias, aut ut ventusve paterve

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.116
passages.text: Causaque sit certe femina nulla morae!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.117
passages.text: Quodsi quam sciero, moriar, mihi crede, dolendo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.118
passages.text: Iamdudum pecca, si mea fata petis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.119
passages.text: Sed neque peccabis, frustraque ego terreor istis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.120
passages.text: Quoque minus venias, invida pugnat hiemps.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.121
passages.text: Me miseram! quanto planguntur litora fluctu,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.122
passages.text: Et latet obscura condita nube dies!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.123
passages.text: Forsitan ad pontum mater pia venerit Helles,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.124
passages.text: Mersaque roratis nata fleatur aquis —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.125
passages.text: An mare ab inviso privignae nomine dictum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.126
passages.text: Vexat in aequoream versa noverca deam?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.127
passages.text: Non favet, ut nunc est, teneris locus iste puellis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.128
passages.text: Hac Helle periit, hac ego laedor aqua.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.129
passages.text: At tibi flammarum memori, Neptune, tuarum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.130
passages.text: Nullus erat ventis inpediendus amor —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.131
passages.text: Si neque Amymone nec, laudatissima forma,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.132
passages.text: Criminis est Tyro fabula vana tui,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.133
passages.text: Lucidaque Alcyone Calyceque Hecataeone nata,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.134
passages.text: Et nondum nexis angue Medusa comis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.135
passages.text: Flavaque Laudice caeloque recepta Celaeno,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.136
passages.text: Et quarum memini nomina lecta mihi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.137
passages.text: Has certe pluresque canunt, Neptune, poetae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.138
passages.text: Molle latus lateri conposuisse tuo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.139
passages.text: Cur igitur, totiens vires expertus amoris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.140
passages.text: Adsuetum nobis turbine claudis iter?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.141
passages.text: Parce, ferox, latoque mari tua proelia misce!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.142
passages.text: Seducit terras haec brevis unda duas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.143
passages.text: Te decet aut magnas magnum iactare carinas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.144
passages.text: Aut etiam totis classibus esse trucem;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.145
passages.text: Turpe deo pelagi iuvenem terrere natantem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.146
passages.text: Gloriaque est stagno quolibet ista minor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.147
passages.text: Nobilis ille quidem est et clarus origine, sed non

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.148
passages.text: A tibi suspecto ducit Ulixe genus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.149
passages.text: Da veniam servaque duos! natat ille, sed isdem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.150
passages.text: Corpus Leandri, spes mea pendet aquis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.151
passages.text: Sternuit en lumen! — posito nam scribimus illo —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.152
passages.text: Sternuit et nobis prospera signa dedit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.153
passages.text: Ecce, merum nutrix faustos instillat in ignes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.154
passages.text: 'Cras' que 'erimus plures,' inquit, et ipsa bibit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.155
passages.text: Effice nos plures, evicta per aequora lapsus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.156
passages.text: O penitus toto corde recepte mihi!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.157
passages.text: In tua castra redi, socii desertor amoris;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.158
passages.text: Ponuntur medio cur mea membra toro?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.159
passages.text: Quod timeas, non est! auso Venus ipsa favebit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.160
passages.text: Sternet et aequoreas aequore nata vias.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.161
passages.text: Ire libet medias ipsi mihi saepe per undas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.162
passages.text: Sed solet hoc maribus tutius esse fretum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.163
passages.text: Nam cur hac vectis Phrixo Phrixique sorore

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.164
passages.text: Sola dedit vastis femina nomen aquis?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.165
passages.text: Forsitan ad reditum metuas ne tempora desint,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.166
passages.text: Aut gemini nequeas ferre laboris onus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.167
passages.text: At nos diversi medium coeamus in aequor

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.168
passages.text: Obviaque in summis oscula demus aquis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.169
passages.text: Atque ita quisque suas iterum redeamus ad urbes;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.170
passages.text: Exiguum, sed plus quam nihil illud erit!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.171
passages.text: Vel pudor hic utinam, qui nos clam cogit amare,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.172
passages.text: Vel timidus famae cedere vellet amor!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.173
passages.text: Nunc, male res iunctae, calor et reverentia pugnant.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.174
passages.text: Quid sequar, in dubio est; haec decet, ille iuvat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.175
passages.text: Ut semel intravit Colchos Pagasaeus Iason,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.176
passages.text: Inpositam celeri Phasida puppe tulit;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.177
passages.text: Ut semel Idaeus Lacedaemona venit adulter,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.178
passages.text: Cum praeda rediit protinus ille sua.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.179
passages.text: Tu quam saepe petis, quod amas, tam saepe relinquis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.180
passages.text: Et quotiens grave sit puppibus ire, natas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.181
passages.text: Sic tamen, o iuvenis tumidarum victor aquarum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.182
passages.text: Sic facito spernas, ut vereare, fretum!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.183
passages.text: Arte laboratae merguntur ab aequore naves;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.184
passages.text: Tu tua plus remis bracchia posse putas?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.185
passages.text: Quod cupis, hoc nautae metuunt, Leandre, natare;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.186
passages.text: Exitus hic fractis puppibus esse solet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.187
passages.text: Me miseram! cupio non persuadere, quod hortor,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.188
passages.text: Sisque, precor, monitis fortior ipse meis —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.189
passages.text: Dummodo pervenias excussaque saepe per undas

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.190
passages.text: Inicias umeris bracchia lassa meis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.191
passages.text: Sed mihi, caeruleas quotiens obvertor ad undas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.192
passages.text: Nescio quo pavidum frigore pectus hebet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.193
passages.text: Nec minus hesternae confundor imagine noctis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.194
passages.text: Quamvis est sacris illa piata meis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.195
passages.text: Namque sub aurora, iam dormitante lucerna,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.196
passages.text: Somnia quo cerni tempore vera solent,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.197
passages.text: Stamina de digitis cecidere sopore remissis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.198
passages.text: Collaque pulvino nostra ferenda dedi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.199
passages.text: Hic ego ventosas nantem delphina per undas

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.200
passages.text: Cernere non dubia sum mihi visa fide,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.201
passages.text: Quem postquam bibulis inlisit fluctus harenis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.202
passages.text: Unda simul miserum vitaque deseruit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.203
passages.text: Quidquid id est, timeo; nec tu mea somnia ride

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.204
passages.text: Nec nisi tranquillo bracchia crede mari!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.205
passages.text: Si tibi non parcis, dilectae parce puellae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.206
passages.text: Quae numquam nisi te sospite sospes ero!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.207
passages.text: Spes tamen est fractis vicinae pacis in undis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.208
passages.text: Tu placidas toto pectore finde vias!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.209
passages.text: Interea nanti, quoniam freta pervia non sunt,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 19.210
passages.text: Leniat invisas littera missa moras.
